validation_rules: All supported providers must have accurate export specifications
Validation rules must cover structural, semantic, and variable dimensions
Template categories must include required and recommended block lists
Quality standards must define clear scoring criteria with thresholds

Version lifecycle must define all state transitions and their preconditions
